sources.title: Wan-Animate - humanaigc.github.io
sources.snippet: Abstract We introduce Wan-Animate, a unified framework for character animation and replacement. Given a character image and a reference video, Wan-Animate can animate the character by precisely replicating the expressions and movements of the character in the video to generate high-fidelity character videos.
